whatItIs.statement: Combines labels, controls, help text, and validation to compose accessible form fields and grouped inputs.

whenToUse.statement: Use Field to structure a form control with its label, helper text, and validation; use FieldSet and FieldLegend for related groups of controls.

howToUse.statement: Associate FieldLabel htmlFor with the control id, add aria-invalid to invalid controls, and render FieldError for validation messages.
Use FieldContent when a horizontal field needs label and description content aligned beside the control.

options.statement: Field orientation supports vertical, horizontal, and responsive; vertical is the default.
FieldError accepts authored children or an errors array and deduplicates repeated messages.
